title: 安田記念の後に・サイレント連覇！

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is it! This is the feelin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second the race ends, Vodka steps up proudly without even glancing at the results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like she got that something she wanted. Something even greater than keeping her streak on a G1.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you won the Yasuda Kinen again!
Yeah, you won the Yasuda Kinen again!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Again?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hold up. Oh yeah, I guess I did win last year…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh, you're right! Winning two years in a row is super cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And I didn't even realize it! How awesome is that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeaaahhh! Did you hear that, fans? Two years in a rooooow!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And not only that, but I didn't even realize it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what she's proving exactly, but seeing as it's cause for celebration, I guess it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I decide to ask Vodka about the dashing technique we've been working on together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yup, I mastered it. I leaned in, sped up, and let the wind take me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm good now. If I can run like this, I'll shine brighter than anyone, anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And not just in mile races, but any distance.
choice_data_list: Even in medium or long-distance races?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, these legs are really workin' for me now. They're pretty fearsome weapons.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Think about it. I've got the edge to beat even the milers who always go on about their speed.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Put me in medium- or long-distance races, where everyone's tired in the homestretch, and my results'll be even better.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is bigger than just winnin' the Yasuda Kinen every year. I'm not gonna lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka stares fearlessly at the sky. The sharp look in her eyes sends a shiver down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt, Vodka has surpassed herself and reached a whole new level.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now I can stand tall in front of any opponent, no matter how strong. Even her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer? Which G1 do you think Scarlet's gonna go for this fall?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking about her personality, Scarlet likes standing out and being number one. On top of that, her legs are strong, so she's not worried about distance…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's what I was thinkin' too. Great minds think alike, eh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In that case, that'll be our decidin' race this Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Lemme run in the autumn Tenno Sho. I wanna get that ultimate title as the ultimate coolest me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You know what's what, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No matter how prestigious the race, I'm not afraid, You know why?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Cause everyone here's loved me since I ran in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Until next time, Tokyo Racecourse! Make sure ya give me some good tailwind next time too!
